WITH active_windows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT w.id,w.region,
           EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM astra_notification_batches b WHERE b.posting_window_id=w.id) AS batched
    FROM posting_windows w WHERE w.ended_at IS NULL
), recipients AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s.slot,s.connected_at,u.id AS user_id,u.secret_key_hash
    FROM unnest($1::text[], $2::text[], $3::timestamptz[])
         WITH ORDINALITY AS s(user_id,region,connected_at,slot)
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=s.user_id AND u.status=? AND u.region=s.region
), legacy AS (
    SELECT s.slot,n.id,n.posting_window_id,n.region,n.created_at
    FROM recipients s
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT n.id,n.posting_window_id,w.region,n.created_at
        FROM active_windows w
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT n.id,n.posting_window_id,n.created_at
            FROM notifications n
            WHERE NOT w.batched AND n.posting_window_id=w.id AND n.user_id=s.user_id
              AND n.created_at>s.connected_at
            ORDER BY n.creat

SELECT CASE WHEN (i.created_at = $3 AND i.xmin::text = $2) OR (i.asset_key IS NOT NULL AND ? || i.asset_key = $2) THEN NULL ELSE i.data END AS data,
          u.id AS owner_id, i.media_type, u.secret_key_hash, i.xmin::text AS version, i.created_at, i.asset_key
   FROM image_objects i
   JOIN LATERAL (
     SELECT id, secret_key_hash, profile_image_id FROM users
     WHERE id = i.owner_user_id AND status = ? OFFSET 0
   ) u ON true
   WHERE i.id = $1 AND (
     u.profile_image_id = i.id
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM posts p
       WHERE p.image_id = i.id AND p.author_id = u.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
     )

       SELECT 1 FROM realmojis r
       JOIN posts p ON p.id = r.post_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

       WHERE r.image_id = i.id AND r.reactor_id = u.id AND r.replaced_at IS NULL AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
     )
   )

          count(p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL) AS active,
          count(p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS deleted
   FROM users u JOIN posting_windows w ON w.region = u.region AND w.ended_at IS NULL
